technical_quality: Adequate inspiration and penetration, no significant rotation; scapulae partially projected over the upper lung fields; L side marker at top right corner (partly cut off). Pediatric film, arms at sides.

devices.location: top right corner of image, lateral to patient's left shoulder (outside the thorax)

abnormalities.finding: patchy ill-defined hazy opacity with peribronchial thickening, perihilar extending laterally (the labelled infiltrate)
increased perihilar bronchovascular markings / peribronchial cuffing without confluent consolidation

description_zh: 胸部X光正面（PA）像，吸氣深度足夠，無明顯旋轉，穿透度適中。左側肺門周圍延伸至中肺野可見片狀、邊界不清之模糊浸潤影，範圍約7公分，伴支氣管周圍增厚；右側肺門周圍亦見支氣管血管紋理增加及支氣管周圍套袖徵，但無明顯融合性實變。心臟大小正常，兩側橫膈輪廓清楚、肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸。影像右上角可見 L 側別標記，未見任何導管、引流管、外科夾或其他植入裝置。
